name: Mailchimp
tagline: Marketing platform API for email campaigns, audiences, and automations
description: Mailchimp provides a REST API for managing email marketing audiences, campaigns, automations, templates, and reporting. Developers authenticate with API keys scoped to a datacenter-specific base URL, then create and manage lists, send campaigns, and pull engagement analytics programmatically.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic Auth (anystring:API_KEY) or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY; key suffix encodes datacenter (e.g. us19). Self-serve from account settings.

use_cases: add or update a subscriber on an audience list
create and send an email campaign
list audience members and their status
pull campaign open and click reports
